combat-service.pet-defeat-announcement: {{petName}} is exhausted today, cannot fight anymore.
config.enable-pet-following.name: Enable Pet Following
config.enable-pet-following.tooltip: Allow your pet to follow you around the world.
config.max-number-followers.name: Max Number of Pets Following
config.max-number-followers.tooltip: effective on next day start after reset.
config.follow-distance.name: Follow Distance
config.follow-distance.tooltip: The distance, in tiles, that your pet tries to maintain from you.
config.added-follow-speed.name: Added Follow Speed
config.added-follow-speed.tooltip: The additional movement speed given to your pet while following you (suggest 3).
config.sound-on-jump-pet.name: Play Jump Sound
config.sound-on-jump-pet.tooltip: Play a sound when your pet jumps to your location.
config.larger-collision-enabled.name: Use Larger Collision Area
config.larger-collision-enabled.tooltip: Use a larger collision area when calculating paths. This can reduce the chance of your pet getting stuck, but may also increase the chance that no valid path is found (pet jumps more).
config.time-to-warp-no-path.name: Time Before Warping
config.time-to-warp-no-path.tooltip: The time, in ticks (60 ticks = 1 second), your pet waits when no valid path can be found before warping to you. This setting is more important when Larger Collision Area is enabled.
config.enable-combat.name: Enable Combat
config.enable-combat.tooltip: (must have Following Enabled) Allow your pet to attack monsters and participate in combat.
config.pet-strength.name: Pet Strength
config.pet-strength.tooltip: Choose how powerful your pet is in combat.
config.show-health-bar.name: Show Health Bar
config.show-health-bar.tooltip: Choose when your pet's health bar is displayed.
